mentions.name: Kirby Blog Photo Posts
mentions.description: This project adds photo post support to the author's Kirby blog so photos taken with a new camera can be shared in one place and cross-posted to Mastodon.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on supporting photo posts on my blog (Kirby), I bought a new camera and thought it would be nice to share them in one place (Cross post to Mastodon).
